finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹800 Cr, EBITDA margin = 22%, Debt = ₹500 Cr, Interest rate = 10%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 15%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹176 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹50 Cr = ₹126 Cr.
New revenue = ₹680 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹150 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹100 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-26 Cr — notice how a 15% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
